name: Monsters Survive ~Makereba Monster ni Seishoku Sareru~
original_name: Monsters Survive ～負ければモンスターに生殖される～
source:
* A Monster Sex Product with the grand force of LiLiTH!
Featuring the designs of popular artist Eru Shindou, by Eri Momono!

* Lose and be inseminated!? Fully loaded monster sex situations!
Monsters spring forth in this game's battles where, if you lose, you'll be copulated and contorted! Reproduction begins, you're injected with aphrodisia, inseminated with seedlings and eggs, so many situations!!

* Choose dangerous dispatch missions, or sell yourself for cash!
In the course of your journey, you'll be faced with a dilemma: perilous quest or harlotry, your choice! It's up to you whether you want to risk insemination in the wild or safely succumb to whorish debauchery!!

* Dispatch choice-based battle system!
Your level is determined by how often you've cleared missions, if your level is low you're monster meat!!
There's also a multiple ending system with various conclusions depending on what does you in! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098913.html]DLsite English[/url]]
